purpose: Implement a source-neutral deterministic coarse-surface baseline that partitions existing geometry-v2 family members before any comparison with review annotations or image-source labels.

allowed_fields: anonymous RGB image declared by the review packet
normalized detected lines and cross-scale stability
forbidden_inputs: C2PA, EXIF, watermark, pixel-detector or camera results

resource_boundary.pairwise_work_scope: Only lines sharing one appearance component are compared; at most two appearance-component memberships are retained per line.
resource_boundary.failure_policy: Image-size mismatch, path escape or posthoc path fails before artifacts are published. Packets above the line cap return not_applicable and are never partially scored.

algorithm_order: Convert the anonymous RGB image to normalized CIE Lab and compute one mean descriptor per fixed grid cell.
Join four-neighbor cells only when their normalized Lab distance is within the frozen threshold; discard components below the cell floor.
For each stable line, sample both sides at five frozen positions and retain the two best appearance components meeting the vote floor.
Within each appearance component, join lines using the frozen spatial, endpoint, axis-relation, local-appearance, region and stability affinity.
Emit connected line components with at least two members as coarse surface candidates; do not assign semantic surface kinds.
Partition each existing family by candidate-surface membership, retaining shared-boundary lines in more than one subfamily and recording every unassigned member explicitly.
engineering_gates: all 36 blind packets complete without reading an annotation or posthoc file
every original family member is present in at least one deterministic subfamily or in the explicit unassigned set
repeated runs produce byte-identical JSON payloads
all declared artifacts exist and no temporary files remain
runtime and output volume stay within the local single-image boundary
deferred_evaluation: comparison with independently completed human blind annotations
same-surface over-splitting and cross-surface overmerge metrics

decision_rules.engineering_gate_failure: Fix implementation defects without opening review answers or source keys; do not tune thresholds against failed examples.
decision_rules.engineering_gate_success: Permit only source-blind diagnostic inspection and later comparison against independent human annotations.
